what_you_believe_happened: Signed in as accounts.audit. Looked in Money > Books & cash, Ledger & setup (and its Chart of accounts and Activity log sub-tabs), Expense categories, Budgets and costs, Reports & tax, the + menu and the Ask assistant. I found no control to add a new account to the chart. Chart of accounts shows only one chart, 'Indian interiors and turnkey projects', marked 'Not installed', with no add-account button, even though the brief said the chart exists. Expense categories only lets you map a category name to an existing account, and the only account offered was 'Material Purchases / Project Expense'. Asking the assistant to add the account made it draft an Expense ticket (#14, 'Draft - not saved', project not chosen). That is the wrong kind of record, so I did not confirm it. I believe the account was not created.

observations: Roughly 22 actions without finding any way to create a ledger account. Nothing on screen says how to add an account. The chart page implies accounts come only from installing a template through an admin-approved ticket. Contradiction between the brief ('chart exists') and the screen ('Not installed'). I did not submit the wrongly drafted ticket #14; it may remain as an unsaved draft.

rating_justifications.feature_discoverability: No add-account control found in Books, Ledger & setup, Chart of accounts, Expense categories, the + menu or Budgets; Chart of accounts only offered an install card marked Not installed.
rating_justifications.ease_of_use: Task could not be completed; the assistant created an unrelated Expense draft instead.
rating_justifications.clarity_of_terminology: Chart of accounts and Expense categories sound like account management but do not allow adding accounts; Direct expenses appears nowhere.
rating_justifications.workflow_efficiency: About 22 actions with no progress, including a long scroll to reach the accounting buttons.
rating_justifications.system_feedback: Expense categories form opened off screen with no cue, and clicking the chart name did nothing.
